name: pxc04f
transitions: real->protected (CR0.PE 0->1, CS far-jump to 32-bit flat code segment 0x08)

page tables: PT0 identity for the low structures/stack/code window EXCEPT PT0[3]: linear 0x3000 -> phys 0x600000, starting NOT-PRESENT; PT1[0] present, PT1[1] not-present (the pfault demand-page target); CR3 load + CR0.PG 0->1

case A (atomicity): fstpl m64 at linear 0x2FFE (beat 0 spans 0x2FFE-0x3001) with page 3 NP -> #PF(CR2=0x3000) BEFORE any commit; the handler verifies the page-1 sentinel 0xA5A5A5A5 at 0x2FFC-0x2FFF is untouched (marker 0x2038=0x600DF00D), maps page 3 -> phys 0x600000, IRETs; the fstpl restarts and completes

case B (correctness, non-contiguous frames): the restarted store's 8 bytes land split across phys 0x2FFE (low dword 0x00000000) and phys 0x600002 (high dword 0x3FF00000); the linear readbacks (0x2FFE -> 0x2040, 0x3002 -> 0x203C) would return 0x5A5A5A5A (unwritten right frame) or 0x0B0B0B0B (wrong-frame poison) for any wrong-physical-page implementation
pfault flow: demand-page #PF at 0x401000 (restart + readback 0xCAFEBABE), #GP on selector 0x38 past the GDT limit, #UD on UD2; counters accumulate to 4

witnesses.ecx at exit: 4 -- two #PF (crossing + demand-page) + one #GP + one #UD all delivered
witnesses.edx at exit: 0x004000F4 -- CR2 0x401000 captured by the demand-page #PF, low 16 bits clobbered by the 0xF4 exit-port load (out's port is always DX)
witnesses.edi at exit: 0x600DF00D -- case A: the page-1 sentinel survived the rejected crossing store (pre-probe rejected BEFORE any write)
witnesses.ebx at exit: 0x3FF00000 -- case B: high dword of 1.0 read back through page 3 (phys 0x600002)
witnesses.ebp at exit: 0x00000000 -- case B: low dword of 1.0 read back through page 2 (phys 0x2FFE)

description: REVIEW1_Aug3 R2-C03 regression for producer S_FSTORE: the generic page-crossing fragment engine must complete a crossing FSTP m64 with architecturally correct results. Differential against QEMU (whose cputlb.c mmu_lookup looks up BOTH pages of a crossing store, recognizing exceptions from either, before any byte commits). Case A: with page 3 not-present the crossing store #PFs with CR2=0x3000 and the page-1 bytes are provably untouched (no partial commit). Case B: with page 3 mapped to the non-adjacent phys frame 0x600000 the restarted store's tail lands on the correct physical page (poisoned wrong frame + seeded right frame make any wrong-physical-page access observable). Built on the pfault skeleton, whose #PF/#GP/#UD deliveries still run and count.
